title: Bound source errors without multiplying by the rare mean
statement: For the SAME invariant pi/maps and all primitive relative errors<=eta<1, K=csc(pi/ell),d=eta*K/sqrt(1-eta) give exp(-2asinh(d/2))<=Mhat/M<=exp(2asinh(d/2)) simultaneously for EVERY target. Log-rate form is |log(Mhat/M)|<=2asinh(K*sinh(delta/2)). No target rarity,huge M,state count or gap enters THIS sensitivity bound. Bounded cycle geometry is essential:biased long cycles keep stationarity and small relative rates while rare means change by unbounded factors. Later Monte Carlo target queries still need their own error allocation.
